basic_details.job_title: NIPER-R Junior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) position at the National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, Raebareli (NIPER-R) is to be held tentatively on 4 December 2026, with reporting between 1:00 and 1:30 PM at the institute's Bijnor-Sisendi Road campus, Sarojini Nagar, Near CRPF Base Camp, Lucknow. There is one post in a CST-UP-sponsored project, with a consolidated fellowship of ₹25,000 per month for the first two years and ₹28,000 for the third year. Only residents of Uttar Pradesh may apply.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 28 years. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/women and physically handicapped candidates as per Govt. of India norms. The notice does not print a date for counting age. | Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

Candidates with the listed postgraduate qualification who are residents of Uttar Pradesh

content_sections.heading: About NIPER-R
content_sections.text: NIPER Raebareli (NIPER-R) is an autonomous Institute of National Importance set up by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, Govt. of India, by an act of parliament. Its purpose is to impart high-quality education and research in the area of Pharmaceutical Sciences. This is a government institute, and the post is a project position, not a regular post.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: MS Pharm/M. Pharm./MTech in Pharmacology/Pharmacology & Toxicology/Regulatory Toxicology/Biotechnology/Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Medicinal Chemistry, OR MVSc in Pharmacology/Pathology/Biotechnology, OR M.Sc. in Biochemistry/Biotechnology Pharmacology/Toxicology/Organic Chemistry. In every case, at least 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale or 60% marks. The candidate must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh. GPAT/GATE/NET qualification and research experience in the related area, for example hands-on experience in animal handling, enzyme-based assay, cell culture, and molecular biology techniques. The maximum age limit is 28 years. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/women and physically handicapped candidates as per Govt. of India norms. The notice does not print a date for counting age. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

rows.pay: ₹25,000/- per month (consolidated) for the first two years; ₹28,000 (consolidated) for the third year

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The filled prescribed application form (format attached to the notice). Attachments: self-attested certificates/documents regarding educational qualifications, work experience etc. Self-attested copies of date of birth proof, degrees, certificates, mark sheets and experience certificates. Incomplete applications, or those without relevant supporting documents, will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Interested candidates in the above area of research may appear for the walk-in interview with the filled application form and attachments. An advance copy of the application form and documents may also be sent to the Principal Investigator by email at [email protected] . The Principal Investigator's address is Dr. Gopal Lal Khatik (Principal Investigator), Department of Medicinal Chemistry, National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER), Bijnor-Sisendi Road, Sarojini Nagar, Near CRPF Base Camp, Lucknow (UP) - 226002.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The selection event named in the notice is the walk-in interview. NIPER Raebareli reserves the right to fix suitable criteria for short-listing eligible candidates, and the project team may put any screening criteria in place if large numbers of applications are received. Possessing the prescribed qualification does not ensure that a candidate will be called for an interview. The committee may also decide not to select any candidate if none is found suitable. Only short-listed or selected candidates will be informed by email, and they need to join within the stipulated time under the project.

content_sections.heading: Terms of the Position
content_sections.text: The position is initially for one year and is extendable up to the project duration based on satisfactory performance. The offer is purely temporary in nature and does not confer any right to absorption, regular appointment or continuation of services in NIPER Raebareli. Selected candidates will be encouraged to apply for the Ph.D. program in the above research area as per the provisions, after fulfilling the required criteria under the institute's rules.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: An application once submitted cannot be altered or resubmitted under any circumstances, and no request to change data entered in the application will be entertained. No TA/DA will be given to candidates for appearing in the interview. For further information, applicants may contact the Principal Investigator directly by email at [email protected] .

faq.question: Q6. What is the fellowship for the JRA post?
faq.answer: The fellowship is ₹25,000 per month (consolidated) for the first two years and ₹28,000 (consolidated) for the third year.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the NIPER-R interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled prescribed application form and self-attested certificates and documents on educational qualifications and work experience, including date of birth proof, degrees, mark sheets and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIPER-R JRA position permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary, initially for one year and extendable up to the project duration based on satisfactory performance. It gives no right to regular appointment.
